spike: Cyrinx roadmap Rank 11a: offline NxM/MIMO feasibility and capacity accounting

allowed_evidence: tracked retained captures and manifests present in this isolated worktree
deterministic synthetic fixtures generated from declared matrices

hypothesis: At fixed total digital sample power and per-speaker peak limits, a phase-coherent, independently driven and independently observed retained 2x2 channel matrix predicts at least 1.35x setup-inclusive net goodput over the best-speaker/SIMO control in at least two of three required geometries.
incumbent: Per-bin best single speaker with all independent receive microphones combined using noise-whitened SIMO combining, under the same active-bin mask, total digital sample power, CP, pilot, control, sounding, and update overhead.

evidence_audit.required_tx: At least two logical speaker channels independently driven within one phase-continuous multichannel render, or an equivalent documented common phase reference.
evidence_audit.required_rx: At least two raw logical microphone channels retained without sample-identical duplication or undocumented mixing.
hard_stop_conditions: speaker columns come from separate phase-incoherent launches
fewer than two independently driven outputs
fewer than two independently retained inputs
undocumented channel mixing or route change
no noise interval or power-accounting provenance
fewer than five matrices in any required geometry

waveform_and_schedule.matrix_probe: One phase-continuous stereo PCM acquisition per repeat. Both transmit columns use mutually orthogonal known OFDM pilot allocations with identical active-bin support; pilot polarity is deterministic from the manifest seed. A leading synchronization chirp and repeated pilot blocks provide timing/CFO/SRO removal and repeat-coherence measurement. Sequential columns are acceptable only as non-overlapping slots in the same uninterrupted stereo render and receive capture.
waveform_and_schedule.payload_probe: Independently seeded randomized QPSK symbols for each stream, encoded as known bits. Actual demapper LLRs are required for bitwise GMI; otherwise GMI is reported unavailable.
waveform_and_schedule.primary_power_class: Fixed sum digital sample power across speakers, with each speaker constrained by the same declared sample-peak limit as the one-speaker control.
waveform_and_schedule.diagnostic_power_class: Equal per-speaker drive at the one-speaker amplitude, explicitly labeled as approximately +3 dB total digital power.
waveform_and_schedule.forbidden_power_claim: No calibrated acoustic/SPL comparison without an instrumented level record.

analysis.channel_estimate: Per-bin complex least-squares H[k] from known orthogonal probes after shared timing/CFO/SRO correction.
analysis.noise_covariance: Per-bin sample covariance from a noise-only interval; use diagonal loading declared in output if inversion is ill-conditioned.
analysis.coherence: Magnitude of normalized complex correlation between aligned repeat channel estimates, computed per path and payload-weighted across active bins.
analysis.residual_phase_sd: Circular standard deviation in degrees after removal of one fitted common delay and common phase per repeat; aggregate as payload-weighted p90 across paths/bins.
analysis.amplitude_stability: Repeat coefficient of variation of abs(H), payload-weighted p90; preregistered bound <= 0.15.
analysis.effective_rank: exp(-sum(p_i * ln(p_i))) from normalized eigenvalues of the noise-whitened H H^H matrix.
analysis.shannon: sum_k log2 det(I + H[k] Q[k] H[k]^H Rn[k]^-1), with Q split equally across active transmit modes for the MIMO diagnostic and all power assigned to each tested speaker for the best-speaker/SIMO control.
analysis.mode2_gmi: Bitwise GMI from actual known QPSK bits and actual demapper LLRs after the declared total-power split; no EVM-to-GMI substitution.
analysis.scheduled_ceiling: Payload bits divided by CP/pilot/FEC/preamble/gap-inclusive schedule duration.
analysis.session_net: Delivered application bits divided by sounding + feedback + profile activation + precoder update + scheduled transfer airtime. Report 64 KiB and 1 MiB transfers.
analysis.uncertainty: Report every repeat and geometry, median and p10 by whole-matrix cluster. Do not resample bins as independent observations.

primary_metric: Predicted setup-inclusive 1 MiB two-mode session-net-goodput ratio versus the best-speaker/SIMO control at fixed total digital sample power.
non_regression_constraints: payload-weighted p90 residual phase standard deviation <= 15 degrees
payload-weighted p90 amplitude coefficient of variation <= 0.15
mode-2 bitwise GMI supports QPSK rate 1/2 on >= 40% of payload-weighted active bins
all setup and update overhead is included
promotion_threshold: Predicted setup-inclusive 1 MiB session-net ratio >= 1.35 in at least two of optimized-near-field, centered-3ft, and lateral-offset-3ft, with every evidence and non-regression gate satisfied.
stop_condition: Stop and publish an identifiability result if the retained corpus lacks any required coherent/independent/provenance evidence. If evidence is identifiable but the gain is 1.15x to <1.35x, stop in the roadmap gray zone. If it is <1.15x, reject two-stream work and retain best-speaker/SIMO analysis.

data_split.calibration: The first two repeats by manifest acquisition order in each geometry may set timing, diagonal loading, and fixed analysis constants.
data_split.held_out: The remaining at least three repeats per geometry decide coherence, mode-2, and gain gates. Whole captures, not bins, are held out.
data_split.synthetic: Synthetic fixtures validate implementation only and never satisfy the measured feasibility gate.

retained_outputs: audit report with explicit rejection reasons
synthetic fixtures and expected numerical results
acquisition manifest/probe design for the next hardware campaign
analysis JSON separating synthetic, retained-replay, and measured-OTA claims
